q: Peraturan Loji Yang Memerlukan Perakuan Kelayakan 2024 mengandungi berapa Bahagian dan peraturan?
c: 7 Bahagian dan 21 peraturan
e: Arrangement: 7 Parts, 21 Regulations, 14 Schedules.

q: Bahagian V peraturan ini berkaitan dengan:
c: Kawalan dan operasi dandang stim
e: Parts: 1 Preliminary; 2 Plant requiring CF; 3 Installation; 4 CF and Inspection; 5 Control and Operation of Steam Boiler; 6 Lifting Machinery; 7 Miscellaneous.

q: Menurut tafsiran, 'safe working load' ialah:
c: Beban maksimum jentera angkat seperti yang dinyatakan dalam reka bentuk
e: Safe working load: maximum load of lifting machinery as specified in the design.

q: 'Lifting machinery' ditakrifkan sebagai:
c: Sebarang peralatan untuk mengangkat, menaikkan, mengangkut atau menurunkan beban
e: Lifting machinery: any equipment for lifting, raising, transporting or lowering loads.

q: 'Hoist' di bawah peraturan ini merujuk kepada:
c: Jentera angkat yang merupakan hoist penumpang dan hoist bahan
e: Hoist: a lifting machinery which is a passenger hoist and a material hoist.

q: Menurut tafsiran, 'pemilik' (owner) termasuk orang yang:
c: Menerima sewa atau keuntungan dengan memajak loji CF
e: Owner: person who receives rent or profit by leasing any plant requiring CF, on his own account or as agent/trustee.

q: Sebelum memasang loji CF, permohonan perlu dibuat kepada KP bagi:
c: Pengesahan reka bentuk dan pembayaran yuran
e: Reg. 4(a): make an application to DG (design verification and payment of fee).

q: Loji CF yang dikilangkan di luar Malaysia (bukan terpakai) mestilah:
c: Baharu dan bebas daripada kemerosotan
e: Reg. 4(e): plant manufactured outside Malaysia is new and free from deterioration.

q: Dandang stim dan jentera angkat perlu dipasang oleh:
c: Orang Kompeten atau pengilang asal
e: Reg. 4(g): steam boiler and lifting machinery installed by CP or origin manufacturer.

q: Jika pemilik ingin memindahkan (relocation) loji CF, dia perlu:
c: Memohon kelulusan bertulis daripada KP
e: Shall apply for written approval if want relocation of CF plant.

q: Semasa pemeriksaan berkala, dandang stim mesti:
c: Tersedia untuk pemeriksaan dalaman
e: Reg. 6: steam boiler available for internal inspection during periodical inspection; pressure vessel also unless designed not subject to internal inspection.

q: Jika loji CF tidak sedia untuk diperiksa, pegawai atau orang berlesen boleh:
c: Menolak menjalankan pemeriksaan dan memaklumkan pemilik secara bertulis
e: Reg. 7: may refuse to inspect CF plant not ready and notify owner in writing; owner resubmits notice when ready.

q: Sebelum membaiki loji CF, pemilik atau penghuni perlu:
c: Menyerahkan notis bertulis kepada pegawai atau orang berlesen
e: Reg. 9 – Repair: submit written notice before repair; repair by CP; tested and examined under CP supervision.

q: Dandang stim mesti berada di bawah kawalan:
c: Jurutera dandang stim, sama ada digaji atau melawat
e: Reg. 12: steam boiler under control of steam boiler engineer (employed or visiting) and operated by a competent person; notify DG of appointment.

q: Keperluan penggunaan lif, eskalator dan walkalator dinyatakan dalam:
c: Jadual Ketiga Belas
e: Reg. 13: owner/occupier shall comply with requirements for use of lift, escalator and walkalator in 13th Schedule.

q: Bagi operasi kren menara dan kren bergerak, Orang Kompeten perlu:
c: Menjalankan ujian ke atas semua suis had (limit) dan peranti keselamatan
e: Reg. 15: operated by CP; lifting plan established; CP complies with instructions and carries out test on all limit switches/safety devices.

q: Alat angkat (lifting tackle) yang digunakan mestilah:
c: Dikilangkan mengikut piawaian yang diiktiraf dan dalam keadaan baik
e: Reg. 16: use lifting tackle manufactured according to recognized standard; ensure in good condition.

q: Rekod dan dokumen loji CF (Peraturan 20) perlu disimpan dalam bahasa:
c: Bahasa Melayu atau Bahasa Inggeris yang mudah difahami
e: Reg. 20: records of design verification, construction, installation, testing, inspection, repair, alteration, maintenance – in Bahasa/English.

q: Peraturan ini TIDAK terpakai kepada:
c: Jentera angkat manual dan jentera angkat yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual Ketiga
e: Reg. 21 Non-application: pressure vessel in Second Schedule; manual lifting machinery and lifting machinery in Third Schedule.

q: Senarai badan pemeriksa yang diberi kuasa terdapat dalam:
c: Jadual Pertama
e: Schedules: First – Authorized Inspecting Body; Second – Pressure Vessel; Third – Lifting Machinery; Fourth – Recognized standards; Fifth – design verification documents; Sixth – Fees.
